blocks.title: <ico-handshake></ico-handshake> MAKE THE DEAL
blocks.intro: Negociar no es pelear: es buscar el punto donde ganan los dos. Estas frases abren la puerta sin ceder de más.

items.en: Is there any flexibility on the price?
items.sp: ¿Hay algo de flexibilidad en el precio? — abres sin exigir.

items.en: What if we agree to a long-term contract?
Would you be willing to meet us halfway?
items.sp: ¿Estarían dispuestos a llegar a un punto medio?

items.en: We can agree to that if you pay a deposit.
I'm confident we can find a solution.
items.sp: Suenas seguro y cooperativo a la vez.

parts.body: What if + verbo, sin to ni will: What if we to split the cost? → What if we split the cost? · What if we will order more? → What if we order more?

cells.body: Could we agree on…? · What if we…? · Would you consider…? · Is there any flexibility on…?
Would you be willing to meet us halfway? · We can agree to that if you… · If you can…, then we could…
I'm confident we can find a solution. · I believe this is a fair proposal. · This offers good value for both sides.
Sé persuasivo pero profesional, y enfatiza el beneficio mutuo — "a win for both sides."

blocks.stage: ① NEGOTIATION LANGUAGE · regatear · contraofertas · confianza

blocks.title: <ico-book></ico-book> CONDITIONALS FOR NEGOTIATION
blocks.intro: Toda negociación es un condicional: «si tú haces esto, yo hago aquello». Para ofertas reales, el first conditional.

cells.body:
If + present, will + base
"If you place a larger order, we will give a discount."

condición para avanzar
Unless we agree, we can't proceed. · We can start as long as the deposit is paid.

parts.body:
2nd (hipotético): If + past, would + base — "If we reduced the price, would you sign a long contract?"
3rd (pasado imaginario): If + past perfect, would have + participio — "If you had accepted the terms, we could have delivered last week."
Ojo: "If you had accepted… we could have delivered…" es 3rd conditional (pasado imaginario), NO 2nd. 2nd = presente/futuro poco probable; 3rd = un pasado que no ocurrió.

blocks.title: <ico-star></ico-star> BUYER vs. SUPPLIER
blocks.intro: Un comprador y un proveedor negocian precio y plazos. Practica los condicionales, y luego escucha dos negociaciones: precio y entrega.

blocks.title: COMPLETE THE CONDITIONAL
blocks.intro: Elige la forma correcta para cada condicional de negociación.

items.q: If you place a larger order, we ___ a discount.
___ you confirm today, the offer will expire.
If we lower the price, ___ you sign today?
We can start ___ the deposit is paid.
( 2nd cond.) If we reduced the price, you ___ commit to a long contract?
If you ___ the deposit today, we will start tomorrow.
We won't sign ___ you include free shipping.

speaking.prompt: Make 2 offers with the first conditional: "If you…, we will…". Then add a counteroffer.
speaking.starter: If you order 100 units, we will offer free shipping. If you pay today, we could add a 5% discount…

blocks.title: 1st vs 2nd CONDITIONAL EN LA NEGOCIACIÓN
blocks.intro: La misma oferta en dos mundos: una está sobre la mesa ahora, la otra es hipotética. Confundirlas en una negociación te cuesta dinero.

pair.b: If you placed a larger order, we would give you a discount.

blocks.intro: Negocia con el proveedor. Elige la jugada profesional y bien dicha.

blocks.title: AUDIO 1 · PRICE NEGOTIATION
blocks.desc: Un comprador y un proveedor negocian el precio. Fíjate en los condicionales y las condiciones.

questions.q: What does the buyer offer for a lower price?
options: An immediate payment and a bigger deposit
A larger order, then a one-year contract
A larger order and an express shipping fee

questions.q: Under what condition does the supplier give 10%?
options: If the buyer commits to a one-year contract
If the buyer increases the order by twenty percent
If the buyer pays the full amount today
Not yet — they need another meeting
Yes — a fair deal for both sides

questions.q: How much discount does the supplier offer at first?

speaking.prompt: You are the buyer. Ask for a better price and offer something in return.

transcript.html: If you lower the price by ten percent, we will place a larger order.
I understand your request, but we can only offer five percent, unless you increase your order by twenty percent.
What if we agree to a long-term contract? Would you consider the ten percent?
If you commit to a one-year contract, we could offer you the ten percent discount.
That works for us. I'm confident this is a fair deal for both sides.

blocks.stage: ④ LISTENING · escucha las negociaciones

blocks.title: AUDIO 2 · DELIVERY DEAL
blocks.desc: Ahora negocian el plazo de entrega. Fíjate en la condición para adelantar la fecha.

questions.q: When can they deliver if the order is confirmed today?
What does the client want instead?
options: A bigger discount on the whole order

questions.q: What condition does the supplier set for Wednesday?
options: A longer contract of one year

questions.q: What does the client decide in the end?

transcript.html: If you confirm the order today, we will deliver by Friday.
I'm a little concerned about the timeline. What if we need it by Wednesday?
We could deliver by Wednesday, but only if you agree to an express shipping fee.
It's a small extra charge. If you accept it, we can guarantee Wednesday.
All right. If you guarantee Wednesday, we will proceed with the order.

blocks.title: <ico-pen></ico-pen> CONFIRM THE DEAL
blocks.intro: Escribe un email corto confirmando un trato que negociaste. Usa 2 frases con primer condicional ("If you…, we will…").
checklist: 2 first conditionals con las condiciones del trato
blocks.placeholder:
Dear ...,
I'm writing to confirm our agreement...
blocks.example:
Dear ___,
I'm writing to confirm our agreement. If you ___, we will ___. Also, if you ___, we will ___. I'm confident this is a fair deal for both sides.
Best regards,
___
blocks.hw: Escribe el email del trato y después grábate diciéndoselo al cliente sin leer, con tono tranquilo y firme.
